mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT q.qna_idx, q.title, q.question, q.created_at, q.user_idx, u.login_id FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE u.user_type = 'ADMIN' AND q.qna_type = '운영정책' ORDER BY q.qna_idx DESC ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna ( qna_idx, title, question, created_at, qna_type, user_idx ) VALUES ( SEQ_QNA.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{question}, SYSDATE, '운영정책', #{user_idx} )
mapper.select: select * from ( select q.qna_idx, q.title, q.question, q.created_at, u.login_id from qna q left join users u on q.user_idx = u.user_idx where q.qna_type = '운영정책' and u.user_type='ADMIN' order by q.qna_idx DESC ) where ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT q.qna_idx AS "QNA_IDX", q.title AS "TITLE", q.qna_type AS "QNA_TYPE", q.created_at AS "CREATED_AT", u.login_id AS "LOGIN_ID", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q.qna_idx DESC) AS RN FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE q.qna_type IN ('서비스', '안내', '이벤트', '점검') ) t WHERE t.RN BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qna WHERE qna_type IN ('서비스', '안내', '이벤트', '점검')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qna WHERE qna_type='운영정책'
